verdict.rationale: Cloudflare documents a one-line scaffolding command (`npm create cloudflare@latest my-app`), and its own Wrangler CLI covers creating, developing, and deploying Workers. The evidence does not show that one command both scaffolds and deploys; deployment appears to be a separate Wrangler step. missing for 10: evidence that a single command scaffolds and deploys end-to-end, the specific deploy command and its flow, independent or hands-on corroboration of the scaffold-to-deploy experience.

support.subject: As a developer, I can scaffold and deploy a new project with a single CLI command

citations.quote: The core Wrangler commands for creating, developing, and deploying Workers are on the Workers commands page.
A command line tool for building [Cloudflare Workers](https://workers.cloudflare.com/).
